warning[ZBX-W0209]: groups show as nogroup inside the container
  cause  a run with devices keeps your groups; inside the container they show as
         'nogroup', and the host's file permissions still decide who may open
         each device
  fix    nothing to do; the groups work, only their names are not shown
  more   zbx explain W0209 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/W0209.html
